translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Brti Drtwrnge Kx Sa Na-aovxioq Kxdrka'-ngrng
Nabz ne Devet, kxnzawz ne Yawe.

content.text: Gct, nzmncngr kxtrka vzdz-zvzm mz nabz kxdrka'-ngrng,
X sc tqrpipebzle badr kx, “Bzkq amrlueamu Gct.”
X batrpzle nzglqpx-lzbq-krdr.
Murde nzrpilr trmcwq alwx rdrng x trna-ayrplapxwq nidr.
Natqdr trka-esz'ngr x yctr-ngrpwz nzpokiangr.
Delc trtxpnzngr nzale-krdr da kxmrlz x tubq.
Mz nrlckxbq sc tzaoti drtwrdr nzryrlq-krdr drtwr kxtrka.
Nzpxtxpx-ngrdr nzti kxtubq mz nzmrlzkr badr lrpzki kx vz-rbr.
Yawe, nzmyatxlzkr nzaodu-zvz-krm
X nzangidati-zvz-krm natqm nzkrlzlzlr bongavz.
Nztubq-krm vzdz krlzbzle newz kxnzmyalzng, x vzo kz la me boongr.
Murde aclve-zpwxq leplz x animol mz nzrsakrlrngr.
Gct, nzaodu-krm leplz mrlz-zlwzm bagr,
Murde apusr-ngrm nigr nei kio kcng tzwxbulvzong lxedr.
Mz nzrka-zvz-krme nagr dakxnzng, dakxnzng lcng yctxpxng zvz.
Murde avzo-zvzme zmrlz ngrm bagr, apule lue kc tqyrletx alo.
X nim narlue r nzlu-krgr,
Kc tqapu-zvzmle bagr nzyrlelz-krm aulz.
Yawe, navz zvz nzaodu-krm nigr kcng tzvz-nqblqlr nim,
Mz nzamrlz-krm kx nabzdr tubq.
Bzkq rlrpx-ngrn mq kxdrka'-ngrng nzlolvz-krdr ninge,
X kxnzglqpx-lzbqng bzkq nanycdr nzrnzlvzolr ninge.
Murde brti drtwrnge nzaovxio-krm kxdrka'-ngrng.
X mz nztao-krdr, trpengr nztulz-mou-krmlr.
